payload.name: Smartphone Battery Depletion Effect on Variety Seeking
payload.fact: A low smartphone battery level reduces consumers' tendency to diversify their product choices.
payload.boundary: Consumer choice behavior in online and offline shopping contexts.

provenance.title: Running Low, Diversifying Less: How Smartphone Battery Depletion Reduces Consumer Variety Seeking
provenance.quote_or_locus: we find that a low (vs. high) smartphone battery level reduces consumers' tendency to diversify their product choices
